mapper.sql: u.user_identity_type = 1 and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and u.user_id != 1 and not exists (select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role sr on sr.role_id=ur.role_id where ur.user_id=u.user_id and sr.role_key='admin')
case when trim(u.nick_name) regexp '^[+0-9() -]{7,}$' or u.nick_name like '%@%' then '求职者' else coalesce(nullif(trim(u.nick_name), ''), '求职者') end

from sys_user u left join t_res_base r on r.rbs_id = ( select r0.rbs_id from t_res_base r0 where r0.rbs_user_id=u.user_id and r0.rbs_status=1 order by r0.rbs_is_default desc, r0.rbs_updated_at desc, r0.rbs_id desc limit 1)

select w.wrk_id as workId, w.wrk_resume_id as resumeId, year(w.wrk_start_date) * 12 + month(w.wrk_start_date) as startMonth, year(case when w.wrk_is_current = 1 then curdate() else least(w.wrk_end_date, curdate()) end) * 12 + month(case when w.wrk_is_current = 1 then curdate() else least(w.wrk_end_date, curdate()) end) as endMonth from t_res_work w where w.wrk_start_date is not null and w.wrk_start_date <= curdate() and (w.wrk_is_current = 1 or (w.wrk_end_date is not null and w.wrk_end_date >= w.wrk_start_date))

left join t_usr_job_preference preference on preference.user_id = u.user_id left join t_res_education school on school.edu_id = ( select e.edu_id from t_res_education e where e.edu_resume_id = r.rbs_id and e.edu_degree between 1 and 5 and e.edu_end_date is not null and e.edu_end_date <= curdate() order by e.edu_degree desc, e.edu_end_date desc, e.edu_id desc limit 1) left join (select edu_resume_id as resumeId, max(case when edu_degree between 1 and 5 then edu_degree else null end) as highestEducation from t_res_education group by edu_resume_id) education on education.resumeId=r.rbs_id left join ( select ordered.resumeId, sum(greatest(0, ordered.endMonth - greatest(ordered.startMonth, coalesce(ordered.previousEndMonth, ordered.startMonth)))) as workMonths from ( select currentWork.resumeId, currentWork.workId, currentWork.startMonth, currentWork.endMonth, max(previousWork.endMonth) as previousEndMonth from () currentWork left join () previousWork on previousWork.resumeId = currentWork.resumeId and (previousWork.startMonth < currentWork.startMonth or (previousWork.startMonth = currentWork.startMonth and previousWork.workId < currentWork.workId)) group by currentWork.resumeId, currentWork.workId, currentWork.startMonth, currentWork.endMonth ) ordered group by ordered.resumeId ) experience on experience.resumeId = r.rbs_id

u.user_id as userId, as name, u.avatar as avatar, nullif(trim(u.current_city), '') as currentCity, nullif(trim(u.target_city), '') as targetCity, case when u.current_status between 1 and 3 then u.current_status else null end as currentStatus, as jobDirection, education.highestEducation as highestEducation, experience.workMonths as workMonths, nullif(trim(school.edu_school), '') as schoolName, nullif(trim(school.edu_major), '') as major, year(school.edu_end_date) as graduationYear, preference.salary_min as salaryMin, preference.salary_max as salaryMax, preference.salary_negotiable as salaryNegotiable, 1 as directoryVersion
mapper.select: select distinct as direction where and is not null order by 1
select distinct trim(u.current_city) trim(u.target_city) as city from sys_user u where and nullif(trim(u.current_city),'') is not null and nullif(trim(u.target_city),'') is not null order by 1
